prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Daily Routine Setup Flow: Adds an interactive routine selector component on the home intro screen so users configure feeding and break alert schedules before entering desktop mode.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Daily Activity Routine", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Save Pet Schedule", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desk Companion Care Ritual Setup Screen: Adds a new setup screen 'new_desk_routine' right after home intro where users choose focus triggers and desktop break intervals.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desk_routine"], "new_desk_routine": {"headline": "Customize Desktop Rituals", "body": "Set up your companion's break reminders and work hours.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Focus Interval", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Complete Setup", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [adoption, reorder] Photo Upload First Adoption Sequence: Reorders the adoption steps so users upload custom photos prior to choosing preset friends, streamlining custom pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "pick_friend", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Companion Path Spotlight Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout showcasing path specific desktop capabilities, background behaviors, and interaction modes.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select how your pet interacts with your desktop environment."}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment & Layering Status Wait Info: Displays GPU rendering, window layering, and display permissions status directly on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 3, "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Checking Desktop Layering Permissions", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Verifying screen overlay capability...", "style": "small"}]}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Save Protection Reassurance Copy: Updates the headline and body on the sign_in screen to explicitly state that signing in prevents pet resets and protects save data across logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure & Preserve Your Pet Data", "body": "Signing in links your pet adoption progress permanently to prevent profile resets."}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray Controls Guidance Hint: Adds a guidance hint on home_intro explaining how to summon, hide, and access system tray controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon anytime to summon, hide, or access settings."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Badge Incentive: Adds an exclusive verified owner seal badge on the adoption certificate screen upon finalizing pet setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Verified Companion Owner Seal", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Desktop Interaction Command Builder Flow: Adds an interactive command key assignment flow on home_intro to let users map custom hotkeys for pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Assign Interaction Hotkeys", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Test Quick Key", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
